summary_text: On this weekend, a single unit of Watermelon Kiran (fresh watermelon) was purchased during the evening. This timing aligns with the population baseline for evening purchases (30.27%), which is comparable to the morning share (32.46%) and higher than afternoon (25.26%) or night (12.02%). The product is a fresh fruit item typically used for immediate consumption or hydration. This is a single observation from one date. It is not yet established whether this represents a stable preference for this specific fruit, brand, or timing. No brand preference can be inferred as the product is unbranded.
